description: This is a PHP test class for the EmployeeAttendanceRecordAPI in the OrangeHRM project. It contains unit tests and integration tests for the API methods such as getAll, getOne, create, delete, and update related to employee attendance records. The class extends EndpointIntegrationTestCase and uses various fixtures and mock services to test API behavior.

classes.name: EmployeeAttendanceRecordAPITest
classes.description: A PHP unit test class for testing the EmployeeAttendanceRecordAPI, including CRUD operations and permission-related hooks within the OrangeHRM attendance module.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of all employee attendance records via the API.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests the getOne method, expected to throw a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Tests the validation rules for getOne method, expected to throw a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests the creation of a new employee attendance record via the API.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests the deletion of an employee attendance record via the API.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating an existing employee attendance record.
